# Sarah Whitman — Major Donor

- **Relationship:** major individual donor; **external, not staff.** (Distinct from
  [Sarah Chen](sarah-chen.md), the Director of Tutoring Programs — different person.)
- **Giving:** **pledged $250,000 over three years** (FY26–FY28), unrestricted — among Keystone's
  most valuable gifts because the money is flexible. Currently in year two.
- **Relationship owner:** [Daniela Cruz](daniela-cruz.md); originally introduced by
  [Gregory Lang](gregory-lang.md).

## What she cares about
- College-access outcomes; she loves the [Bright Futures](../projects/bright-futures-fall.md)
  enrollment numbers and wants student stories, not spreadsheets.
- Being invited to the [Annual Gala 2026](../projects/annual-gala-2026.md) as a table host.

## How to steward her
- Happy to be named publicly and thanked warmly; enjoys recognition and events.
- Send a personal update from Cam each quarter with a real student story.
